description: This file is a Python source code defining classes and functions for managing test plans, test suites, and test instances in Zephyr's Twister testing framework. It includes logic for loading configurations, filtering tests, handling platforms, and generating test subsets.

classes.name: TestLevel
classes.description: Represents a test level with associated scenarios and inheritance.

classes.name: TestPlan
classes.description: Main class for managing test plans, including loading configurations, filtering, and generating test subsets.

classes.name: Filters
classes.description: Defines constants for different filter types used in test filtering.

methods.name: get_level
methods.description: Retrieve a test level by name.

methods.name: parse_configuration
methods.description: Load and parse test configuration from a YAML file.

methods.name: find_subtests
methods.description: Identify sub-tests to run based on options.

methods.name: discover
methods.description: Discover test suites and scenarios, handle modules, and parse configurations.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Load test instances from a JSON file.

methods.name: apply_filters
methods.description: Apply various filters to select tests based on options and platform compatibility.

methods.name: generate_subset
methods.description: Generate a subset of tests for parallel or limited execution.

methods.name: handle_modules
methods.description: Retrieve enabled modules from the Zephyr environment.

methods.name: report
methods.description: Generate reports based on options (test tree, list, tags).

methods.name: report_duplicates
methods.description: Detect and report duplicate test scenarios.

methods.name: report_tag_list
methods.description: Print all tags used in test suites.

methods.name: report_test_tree
methods.description: Display test cases in a tree structure.

methods.name: report_test_list
methods.description: Print a list of all test cases.

methods.name: config
methods.description: Log coverage platform information.

methods.name: add_configurations
methods.description: Load platform configurations from YAML files.

methods.name: get_all_tests
methods.description: Retrieve all test case names.

methods.name: add_testsuites
methods.description: Discover and add test suites from filesystem.

methods.name: get_platform
methods.description: Retrieve a platform object by name.

methods.name: load_from_file
methods.description: Load test instances from a JSON file, applying platform filters.

methods.name: verify_platforms_existence
methods.description: Check if specified platform names exist in the known platform list.

methods.name: create_build_dir_links
methods.description: Create symbolic links for build directories to limit path length.

methods.name: _create_build_dir_link
methods.description: Create a symbolic link for a single build directory.

methods.name: add_instances
methods.description: Add test instances to the internal collection.

methods.name: get_testsuite
methods.description: Retrieve test suite(s) by identifier.
